import torch
from safetensors.torch import load_file
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
sd = load_file('/app/merged_model/model.safetensors')
ad = torch.load(hf_hub_download('dominguesm/xlm-roberta-base-lora-language-detection','adapter_model.bin'), map_location='cpu')
print('--- classifier (modules_to_save) vs adapter ---')
for k in [k for k in ad if 'classifier' in k]:
    mk = k.replace('base_model.model.','roberta.')

import torch
from safetensors.torch import load_file
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
sd = load_file('/app/merged_model/model.safetensors')
ad = torch.load(hf_hub_download('dominguesm/xlm-roberta-base-lora-language-detection','adapter_model.bin'), map_location='cpu')
import transformers, logging; transformers.logging.set_verbosity_error()
from transformers import XLMRobertaForSequenceClassification, XLMRobertaConfig
base = XLMRobertaForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained('FacebookAI/xlm-roberta-base', config=XLMRobertaConfig.from_pretrained('FacebookAI/xlm-roberta-base'), ignore_mismatched_sizes=True).state_dict()
alpha,r=16,8
ok=True
for L in range(12):
  for m in ['query','value']:
    key=f'roberta.encoder.layer.{L}.attention.self.{m}.weight'
    A=ad[f'base_model.model.roberta.encoder.layer.{L}.attention.self.{m}.lora_A.weight'].float()
    B=ad[f'base_model.model.roberta.encoder.layer.{L}.attention.self.{m}.lora_B.weight'].float()
    expected = base[key].float() + (alpha/r)*(B@A)
    d=(sd[key].float()-expected).abs().max().item()
    if d>1e-5: ok=False; print('MISMATCH',key,d)
print('all 24 q/v weights equal base + (alpha/r)*B@A :', ok)
" 2>&1 | grep -viE "warning|load report|^ *-|^\[trans"
